Name: Emily Extra Dialogue
Author: Giantkiller311
Description:
[b]Emily Extra Dialogue[/b] adds 300+ new dialogue lines for Emily, written to feel lore friendly and natural like they were always part of the base game. Every line is crafted to match Emily's personality and spirit.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Seasonal dialogue for every season, rainy days, and Year 1 specific lines[/*]
[*]300+ dialogue lines across pre and post marriage with seasonal awareness, dynamic reactions and special lines for kids[/*]
[*]Haley, Gus, and Lewis react to your growing relationship with Emily[/*]
[*]Four new cutscenes, including a quiet night on the beach and a midnight swim under the stars. [/*]
[*]Full i18n localization support for translators[/*]
[*]Introduces long conversations instead of short one or two line dialogue[/*]
[/list]
[b]Translations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Portuguese by Necromante96Official[/*]
[*]Chinese by tangyixin0409[/*]
[*]Russian by Vica12[/*]
[*]Spanish by Hayato2236
[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:[/b] PC & Android | Stardew Valley 1.6 | Requires SMAPI + Content Patcher | Compatible with SVE, RSV & Date Night Redux

Enjoying the mod? Leave an endorsement and check out my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46269]Spouses Cook for You[/url], which lets your spouse cook meals for you daily with new dialogue lines and cutscenes. Supports all female & male spouses!

Downloads.Description:
• Added a bunch of new dialogue, including post marriage and Year 1 dialogue
• Added two new cutscenes one on the farm and the second in the secret woods
• Fixed a ton of dialogue variation issues you'll see and notice more dialogue
• Like it? Endorse!
